_comment: Hand-maintained observation of what the registries actually serve today. This is NOT proof evidence: nothing here is generated, and nothing here asserts that a pair works. It exists because a pair can be superseded on the registry while its proof stays perfectly valid, and recommending a superseded pair can be actively harmful even when its evidence is sound. Update this file when a publish lands, then run: npm run compatibility:generate
reason: The Phase 10 unified-surface release train (D-118, published under D-123/D-124/D-125) replaced the evidenced 0.2.3/0.4.3 pair. The evidence for that older pair remains valid and is retained; it is simply no longer the pair a user should install.
hazard: Do not install visp-kit@0.2.3 while visp-hyper-agent@0.7.0 is present. visp-kit@0.2.3 declares the `visp` binary that visp-hyper-agent@0.7.0 now provides, so whichever installs last silently wins the name.

provenance.note: That proof covers the published pair, but it is a different report shape than this matrix's evidence pipeline consumes. Until that pipeline is re-run, this matrix makes no support claim about the published pair.
